headline.title: Bangladesh’s Pathao takes its app offline after a cyber incident
headline.quip: The app took its own critical systems offline, which is one way to make sure nobody else can.
headline.summary: After a cybersecurity incident, Pathao took critical systems offline, causing service disruptions across its ride-hailing and delivery platform. Services came back shortly after, with intermittent issues. The company believes names, email addresses and phone numbers were obtained.

reasons: Backfilled during setup and reviewed by the owner.
